description: A swift assassin born from Embercradle's ash storms, who vanishes into smoke and reappears with burning precision. Embers trail their every strike.
icon_hint: curved dagger trailing gray smoke and glowing ember sparks
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy ashblade smoke assassin class. Scorched dark metal border with trailing grey smoke wisps and ember spark corners. Ashen grey-black center with drifting cinder particles and faint heat shimmer. Small smoke-trailing dagger silhouette at bottom. Color palette: ash grey, cinder orange, smoke grey. No characters, no text.
